proof.text: Construct localized comparison maps on an affine basis, descend them by exactness of the formal gluing complex, and glue the resulting coherent morphisms over X.

lean.statement:
theorem torsionControlled_completion_hom_lift_raw
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (J : X.IdealSheafData)
    (H F F' : CoherentModules X) (a : F ⟶ H) (a' : F' ⟶ H)
    (ha : (∃ s : ℕ, 1 ≤ s ∧
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι s).2
        (kernel a.hom)) ∧
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι s).2
        (cokernel a.hom))))
    (ha' : (∃ s : ℕ, 1 ≤ s ∧
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι s).2
        (kernel a'.hom)) ∧
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι s).2
        (cokernel a'.hom)))) :
    ∃ g : F ⟶ F', g ≫ a' = a
